description: Pocket Guide to Transportation-Transportation Services Index (TSI) is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. The Transportation Services Index (TSI) data provides a monthly snapshot of the volume of services performed by the for-hire transportation industry. It is a major economic indicator that helps analysts understand the relationship between the transportation sector and the broader economy. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 4 columns, among them Date, Passenger TSI, Combined TSI, Freight TSI. The portal shows 2025-03-21 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
